insight: Focused sequential engineering beats swarms for depth. Swarms go wide fast; one human with clear eyes goes deep slow. Depth compounds. Width evaporates.
Think foundations and invention, not quick monetization. The builders who chased the rent in year one never owned the land in year ten. Architecture is the long monetization.
The best part is no part. Every new element is debt — a thing to document, test, migrate, deprecate, explain. Subtraction is the senior move.
Session discipline compounds like interest. One disciplined session is a rounding error. A hundred in a row is a different person. The rhythm is the alpha.
Memory without time is dangerous. A fact that was true in March can lie to you in April — and it will, confidently. Temporal awareness is the frontier of trustworthy memory.
